title: VMC-QF — Vacuum Microcavity Quantum Foam: A Manifold-Free Quantum Substrate with Cadence Time and Topological Solitons
description: VMC-QF is a self-contained theoretical vault constructing emergent spacetime structure — metric, causality, and particles — from a discrete graph of finite-dimensional quantum microcavities with intrinsic cadence time. Four core axioms define the substrate, quantization, balance law, and cadence phase-leak; a five-around-one geometric frustration (angular deficit δθ = 7.356103°) anchors topological soliton formation; scale-bridge documents carry the dynamics to mesoscopic effective equations and phase hydrodynamics. All results are model-level with explicit falsification criteria; no empirical claim is made.
